cards.card_text: Tucked in there is Anah, who found the hot springs in the wilderness while pasturing his father Zibeon's donkeys.
cards.verse_text: (This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.) These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
cards.snippet: …Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.) These are the children of Anah:…

cards.card_text: There, a man finds him wandering in the field, and Joseph asks him where his brothers are pasturing their flocks.
cards.verse_text: “Can you please tell me where they are pasturing their flocks?”
cards.snippet: “Can you please tell me where they are pasturing their flocks?”
